item.content:encoded:
Limbs, facial features and [REDACTED] appear to be relocated randomly

Autopsy showed wide-scale reorganisation of the subject's internal organs, including small-scale fusing of parts of the small intestine and [DATA EXPUNGED], resulting in contamination of the chest cavity [DATA EXPUNGED].

Right. So…there are secret parts of the human body that must be kept from the people's knowledge? What reason could there be to redact these? To not offend extremely delicate sensibilities? Is that at all a concern here?

Take all my unironic upvotes, you old bastard.

OK, I've changed the image to one more representative of the object's supposed effect, and I'm working on a tweak for the 'thing what makes you use it so you die horribly' aspect. And yes, that should probably go on the list of overdone cliches.

As for the video, perhaps if I changed it so that only parts were recorded (interference, spatial distortion, camera damage, etc.). That way we get to see some of the creepy transformation, but not all of it.

EDIT (23:43): Compulsion essentially removed (reduced to a vague one-line theory), and the video transcript has been tweaked slightly.
To avoid creating a needless separate post: Yoric, I'm glad you like my replacement. Your image was creepy, but just didn't seem to fit where I was going with the effect, sorry!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I'm going to have to agree regarding the compulsion (potentially worth adding to the Big List of Overdone SCP Cliches?) and the picture (sorry yoric). That said, the whole "now I know and I wish I didn't" aspect is kinda cool. Also, I'm torn over the video recording of the action of 290 - on the one hand, having the victim's body seemingly rearranging itself is definitely creeptastic, but having it actually known takes some of the mystery out of the object, and I'm not really sure whether it's worse to know or not know what exactly happens.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
It's better, but still not great. The picture is nice and odd but doesn't exactly fit the article since it appears to be a pile of disconnected pieces instead of a human body remix. Another thing that keeps me from really getting into it is the compulsion to enter the object; it seems like every other SCP that is dangerous also instills a compulsion to pick it up/eat it/play with it/crawl inside it etc. I'm tired of seeing that particular ability when it doesn't seem to be related to the rest of the SCP, except as a way to make the item seem more dangerous than if you could just ignore it.

But the rewrite as a whole is very well written.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Suggestions:

-"SCP-290 enjoys conversation, no personnel are permitted to talk to it, disregard of this order is suspension of 1 week minimum." should be within the Special Containment Procedures. Further, there should be some justification for why personnel are not allowed to talk to the SCP.

-"SCP-290 is to be held… at all times. SPC-290 is to never leave…" is a bit redundant. Perhaps these two sentences can be rephrased as "SCP-290 is to be held in a 10x10x10 holding cell located 20 meters underground at all times. SCP-290 is not to be permitted to come into contact with any organic matter."

-Why is it so important that SCP-290 kept away from organic material? Why does SCP-290 deserve the Keter class designation? These questions need to be answered within the description of the SCP, otherwise this SCP should be reclassified as Safe especially considering that it was captured with "no trouble at all'.

item.content:encoded:
I like the concept very much, however the whole report is very weak and needs alot of work.

-the containment should be more descriptive, the people who enter the cell should be terminated and autopsied (only autopsied if they were changed)
-I dont think the threat of suspension would do much, they should probably be threatened with termination, your sentences about the language abilities need to be fleshed out.
-Also i dont think a missionary group would be able to contact the organization… they are kinda secretive about what they do, maybe if the group went missing and was found by the native gov't which then led to an agent or the org finding out

these are just some suggestions, you dont have to take any of them. interesting idea though.
